directRegionHistoricalReferenceRule: Existing immutable v1.3.0 DEC-, EV-, and SRC-valued references inside direct correction regions remain exact-value. Their pointer/value set may not be added to, removed, aliased, or replaced; the exact baseline set is closed.

patternSemantics.unicodeMode: No implicit flags; strict UTF-8 decodes to an ECMAScript String and matching uses ECMA-262 UTF-16 code-unit semantics.
